title: Michael Moorcock's Hawkmoon The Sword of the Dawn First Comics Complete 1-4
descriptionText:
The product is a complete set of Michael Moorcock's Hawkmoon: The Sword of the Dawn comic series, featuring the character Hawkmoon and part of the US Comics tradition. The comics were written by Michael Moorcock and illustrated by Rafael Kayanan and Roger Salick, and were published by First Comics in 1987. The series falls under the science fiction genre, with a colorful style and targeted towards a general audience. The set includes issues 1-4, making it a valuable addition for collectors of comic books and fans of the Hawkmoon universe.

Complete 4 issue set of Michael Moorcock’s Hawkmoon The Sword of the Dawn published by First Comics.
Includes
Issue 1
Issue 2
Issue 3
Issue 4
All comics are bagged and boarded. Covers present well with strong color, clean edges, and no major creases or tears visible. Spines look solid across the set. Overall Very Fine condition. Please review photos for exact condition.
Classic sword and sorcery fantasy adaptation by Michael Moorcock with striking cover art throughout the series.
